# awacino_company (Data Source)

The company the API key belongs to: plan, packages, seats, Beam-in devices and the access rules the server enforces today (`access_capabilities`). Any key with the Users or Connections section.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_company" "this" {}

output "free_seats" {
  value = data.awacino_company.this.seats_total - data.awacino_company.this.seats_used
}

# Use only the reach values the server enforces today.
output "can_restrict_to_one_device" {
  value = contains(data.awacino_company.this.access_capabilities, "device")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `access_capabilities` (List of String) Reach / internet values the server enforces and therefore accepts in grants and codes (for example `network`, `device`).
- `audit_retention_days` (Number) Audit log retention in days.
- `beamin_devices_total` (Number) Beam-in devices of the plan (null when the API does not report it).
- `beamin_devices_used` (Number) Beam-in devices used (null when the API does not report it).
- `grants_available` (Boolean) Whether access grants are available (Management package).
- `id` (String) Company id.
- `name` (String) Company name.
- `packages` (List of String) Packages (`management`, `security`, `identity`, `compliance`, `branding`, `api_access`).
- `plan` (String) Plan (`basic`, `standard`, `premium`).
- `seats_total` (Number) User seats of the plan.
- `seats_used` (Number) User seats taken (active members + open invitations).
